from flask import Flask, render_template
import jinja2

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/blog')
def blog():
    template_dir = 'templates'
    jinja_env = jinja2.Environment(
        loader=jinja_env.FileSystemLoader(template_dir),
        autoescape=True)

    template = jinja_env.get_template('blog.html')
    return template.render()
